title: The Four Ways to Get Customers
hook_text: MOST BUSINESSES FAIL BECAUSE OF ONE CHANNEL

beats.say: Most businesses go broke because they rely on a single way to get customers. Here are the four channels that actually bring in revenue.
beats.visual: Cinematic overhead shot of a dark empty desk with a single blank notepad, dramatic side lighting.

beats.say: According to author Alex Hormozi, every customer on earth comes from just four core channels.
beats.visual: A vintage rotary phone resting on a concrete surface, shallow depth of field, moody shadows.

beats.say: Most beginners pick only one method and quit when it fails.
beats.visual: Close up of a hand sliding a wooden chess piece across a dark board, dim lighting.

beats.say: The first method is warm outreach. That means messaging people you already know.
beats.visual: A person writing notes in a worn leather journal by the light of a single desk lamp.

beats.say: The second is free content. You put out valuable ideas online so buyers find you.
beats.visual: A modern laptop resting on a wooden table in a dimly lit room, glowing screen blur.

beats.say: The third is cold outreach. You message strangers who need what you sell.
beats.visual: A close up of fingers typing rapidly on a mechanical keyboard, dark moody atmosphere.

beats.say: The fourth is paid ads. You exchange cash for attention.
beats.visual: A close up of a glowing streetlamp casting long shadows on wet pavement at night.

beats.say: Most people ignore three of these and wonder why they have zero sales.
beats.visual: A dark city street viewed from a high window, soft motion blur of distant headlights.

beats.say: Do 100 reach-outs, post 100 minutes of content, or run $100 in ads every day for 100 days.
beats.visual: A minimalist wall calendar with bold black numbers, shot in stark natural light.

beats.say: But here is the honest catch. About 1 in 5 businesses close in their first year according to federal data.
beats.visual: A closed heavy wooden door with an old brass lock, dramatic shadows and dust motes.

beats.say: Building active income takes years of grit, not a lucky break.
beats.visual: A person walking alone down a long empty concrete corridor, dramatic side lighting.

beats.say: Follow for the money rules school never taught you.
beats.visual: A calm dark horizon at dusk with the last sliver of sun fading away.

caption: The four ways to get customers. Stop relying on just one channel. #money #business #entrepreneur #wealth
description: Map out the only four fundamental methods to acquire paying customers and why beginners fail by ignoring three of them.
first_comment: Which of the four customer channels do you use the most right now?
